description: Source code for a Chromium project component implementing VP8 video encoding delegate using VA-API on Raspberry Pi 4. It manages encoding parameters, frame headers, reference frames, and submits encoding buffers.

classes.name: VP8VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for VP8 encoding using VA-API, managing encoding parameters, frame headers, reference frames, and buffer submissions.

classes.name: VP8VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate::EncodeParams
classes.description: Structure holding encoding parameters such as keyframe period, framerate, QP range, and error resilience mode.

methods.name: QindexToQuantizer
methods.description: Converts Qindex (0-127) to libvpx VP8 quantizer parameter (0-63).

methods.name: MaxSizeOfKeyframeAsPercentage
methods.description: Calculates maximum keyframe size as a percentage of buffer, based on buffer size and framerate.

methods.name: CreateRateControlConfig
methods.description: Creates VP8 rate control configuration based on encode size, parameters, bitrate, and temporal layers.

methods.name: GetVP8Picture
methods.description: Retrieves VP8Picture object from an EncodeJob.

methods.name: GetDefaultVp8FrameHeader
methods.description: Generates default VP8 frame header with specified keyframe flag and visible size.

methods.name: UpdateFrameHeaderForTemporalLayerEncoding
methods.description: Updates VP8 frame header for temporal layer encoding based on frame number and layer configuration.

methods.name: GetActiveTemporalLayers
methods.description: Determines active temporal layers from bitrate allocation.

methods.name: VP8TLEncodingIsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VP8 temporal layer encoding is enabled (feature flag).

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the VP8 VA-API encoder delegate with configuration, validating profile, size, bitrate mode, and setting up rate control.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the coded size of the video frame.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns maximum number of reference frames supported.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns resolutions for scalable video coding layers.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job by setting frame headers, keyframe, and reference frames.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an encode job, including VP8-specific info and QP.

methods.name: BitrateControlUpdate
methods.description: Updates rate control with encoded chunk size and frame parameters.

methods.name: UpdateRates
methods.description: Updates encoding rates based on new bitrate allocation and framerate.

methods.name: SetFrameHeader
methods.description: Sets the VP8 frame header for a given frame number, including temporal layer info.

methods.name: UpdateReferenceFrames
methods.description: Refreshes reference frames after encoding a new frame.

methods.name: SubmitFrameParameters
methods.description: Submits encoding buffers for sequence, picture, and quantization matrices to VA-API.
